e3.notes: Team(mode=route) leader calls delegate_task_to_member(member_id, task); Specialist receives only the task string as a fresh user message (no leader history; add_team_history_to_members off by default). Member run shares session_id, gets parent_run_id=team run_id; team tool record gets child_run_id. Member HITL requirements are copied onto the team run (member_agent_id, member_run_id); after restart the team row is loaded from SQLite, requirement confirmed, Team.continue_run resumes the member run by member_run_id and Specialist continues with its full own history (user, assistant, tool, assistant, tool). Specialist model exception -> member run status ERROR, the error string becomes the delegate tool result, team run status COMPLETED with that content.

e5.notes: per-run times include the fake tools' 2 ledger fsyncs (same in every candidate harness). durable = SqliteDb with default checkpoint='runs' (one terminal write); durable_tool_batch adds a checkpoint per tool batch.
